notes.title: Support me on Patreon!
notes.content:
Hey! Hope you're doing great :)
I've decided to create a [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks]Patreon [/url]for the game. Patrons will receive only cosmetic abilities, such as:
[list]
[*] displaying in the player list as golden
[*] displaying in the menu as patron
[/list]
Patrons will also get early updates and access to prerelease versions :)
The more support I get, the more time I'll spend on updates as well! And obviously they'll be more frequent.
The subscription costs 5€ a month. You can support me there: [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks]https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks[/url]
Thank you if you wish to support me, it's okay if you don't!
Have a great day,
Deepest Inertia Studio

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1.7 Release Build 2
Update Notes for Version 1.1.7 Release Build 1
notes.content:
Version 1.1.7 - release build 1
- Changed some networking (hopefully fixes the issue with not being to join a server with a lot of people)
- Fixed the gm_rhine basement being flooded (it's related to lore I swear guys!)
- Added ability to disable people from spawning and using fireworks in the T menu (show mode)
- Fireworks: 30mm Frankenstein in Cakes
- New map - Show Zone
- Mods now load without freezing the game
- Fixed some bugs
- Pyroville is now winter edition :)

Sorry for the absent of updates and that I didn't add many things in this update. I don't have much time recently so sorry about that. I hope you still like it!
Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update Notes for Release Build 5
notes.content:
- Changed the time of day to afternoon by default to decrease confusion
- Modded items in the spawn menu now only appear if the host has them as well
- Disabled HDR (apparently on HDR monitors the game had a black screen, I turned it off now and since I don't have an HDR monitor I can't sadly make it work)

- Custom keybindings save now
- Fixed M-40 firecracker chain
- Fixed X and Y keybinds being triggered while typing in the chat
